title: Altar of Incense
summary: The altar of incense stood before the veil and was connected with priestly service and fragrant offering before the Lord.
background: The incense altar belonged to the holy place and had a regular role in worship. It helps explain temple service scenes such as Zechariah in Luke 1.
teachingHelp: Use the altar to show ordered priestly worship and the nearness-yet-separation symbolized by the temple arrangement.
